claude-bridge/claude-fable-5.character: Advisory: The advisor's own session model and the default planner. The advisor session runs at medium; planner nodes run at high. Shares the Anthropic session allowance — generally avoid assigning checking, review, reduction, browser verification, or implementation. When Anthropic capacity is reached, planning falls back to Grok at high and the advisor session switches to Grok.

claude-bridge/claude-sonnet-5.character: Advisory: Luna replacement: cheap short-leash procedural work. Scouting, mechanical chores, routine mid-phase checks, repair verification, test-harness findings, and browser verification — deterministic anchors backstop it. Default reasoning is medium. Generally avoid assigning adversarial-tier checking, final whole-diff review, reduction, planning, or substantial implementation. Grok is the hefty-cycle model.

cursor/grok-4.6.character: Advisory: The hefty cycle: implementation workhorse and adversarial-tier reviewer. Backend, data, mixed-stack, substantial existing-UX, greenfield UX (load frontend-design), research, schema/auth/security/money checks, final whole-diff review before PR, rechecks after an overturned pass, and reduction. Also the planning/advisor fallback when Fable is at Anthropic capacity. 200K window — keep packets bounded and split oversized reviews per package or phase. A Grok review of a Grok build is expected in this profile; the deterministic anchors are the independence backstop, not a second model. This guide recommends Cursor only as cursor/grok-4.6. Preserve Cursor catalog fast-mode default.
